title: Uniform small-ball mass bounds along a subsequence (finite upper density of the limit mass measure)
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ and let T_j ∈ D_n(ℝ^P) (j ∈ ℕ; GeometricCurrentOn univ n) with sup_j M(T_j) < ∞. Then there is a strictly increasing φ : ℕ → ℕ such that for Hⁿ-a.e. x ∈ ℝ^P (Hⁿ = μHE[n]) there are C ∈ ℝ and r₀ > 0 with the following property: for every r ∈ (0, r₀), M_{B_r(x)}(T_{φ(j)}) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal(C·rⁿ) for all sufficiently large j.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (Tj : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl P)) n), (⨆ j, (Tj j).mass) < ∞ → ∃ φ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ ∧ ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)), ∃ C r₀ : ℝ, 0 < r₀ ∧ ∀ r ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) r₀, ∀ᶠ j in atTop, (Tj (φ j)).massOn (ball x r) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (C * r ^ n)
